identity.title: CVE-2026-111927
identity.description: Coder before 2.29.20, 2.33.0 before 2.33.12, 2.34.0 before 2.34.8, and 2.35.0 before 2.35.4 contains an improper hostname validation flaw in GetWorkspaceProxyByHostname whose SIMILAR TO pattern performs a prefix match, so any domain that is a string prefix of a workspace-proxy access URL is trusted as a proxy. Attackers owning such a domain can lure an authenticated victim to a crafted /api/v2/applications/auth-redirect link, capture the redirected application_connect API key, and replay it to access the victim's workspace apps.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: Enterprise dev platform (Coder) with high-severity API key theft via auth redirect, plausible enterprise footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111924
identity.description: Fleet before 4.83.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory by sending gzip-compressed request bodies. Attackers can send small, highly compressed requests with Content-Encoding: gzip to unauthenticated endpoints that expand during decoding, crashing the entire Fleet instance.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-409: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated remote DoS in enterprise endpoint management platform (Fleet), public-facing and high severity.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111923
identity.description: Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment property list parsing that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a crafted binary plist payload of about 150 bytes to the enrollment endpoints, triggering exponential allocation or infinite recursion that exhausts CPU and memory.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated remote crash in enterprise MDM platform (Fleet) via enrollment endpoint parsing.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111922
identity.description: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 contains a permissive CORS configuration that trusts every localhost and 127.0.0.1 port with credentials, even when service.publicurl is set. Attackers controlling a page on any localhost port can send a credentialed request to the token refresh endpoint and read the returned bearer JWT to take over the logged-in user's account.

barriers.summary: local, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

_relevance.reason: JWT theft and account takeover via permissive CORS in self-hosted task management platform (Vikunja).

identity.title: CVE-2026-111919
identity.description: Vikunja 0.22.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper access revocation vulnerability that allows removed collaborators to keep receiving project data through webhooks they created. Former collaborators keep receiving task titles and descriptions through their webhook, including content created after their access was revoked.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Access revocation bypass in self-hosted task management platform (Vikunja) allowing continued data access via webhooks.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111917
identity.description: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper session validation vulnerability that allows attackers to keep WebSocket access after revocation because handleAuth never checks the JWT sid claim against the sessions table. Attackers holding a stolen access token can open or maintain connections to /api/v2/ws after session deletion or TOTP enrollment, continuing to receive the victim's notification.created pushes, including comment, task and project content.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Session validation bypass ignoring JWT sid claim in self-hosted platform (Vikunja), allowing persistent access after revocation.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111914
identity.description: Admidio from 5.0.11 before 5.0.16 contains a broken access control vulnerability in modules/inventory/inventory_data.php that allows authenticated users to bypass the inventory_module_enabled restriction. Attackers with any valid login can request the DataTables JSON feed to read every inventory item and keeper names, even when the module is disabled.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Broken access control in membership management system (Admidio) allowing unauthorized inventory data access.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111912
identity.description: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in ForumService::saveTopic() that allows authenticated members to modify other users' forum topics. Attackers can replace the topic_uuid parameter in their own topic_save request, reusing their CSRF token, to overwrite the victim topic's title and first post.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Insecure direct object reference in membership management system (Admidio) allowing unauthorized forum topic modification.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111910
identity.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in attachment.php that allows attackers to download attachments of restricted FAQs by bypassing per-record permission checks. Low-privileged users with the dlattachment right, or anonymous users when allowDownloadsForGuests is enabled, can request attachment IDs to retrieve confidential files from restricted FAQs.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authorization bypass in FAQ management system (phpMyFAQ) allowing download of restricted attachments.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111911
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability where WebAuthn registration endpoints attach credentials to any account without authentication or challenge validation. Attackers can stage a victim username, submit a forged fmt=none attestation to register a passkey, then log in bypassing passwords and TOTP for account takeover.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass targeting WebAuthn and TOTP mechanisms enabling account takeover in enterprise FAQ software.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111909
identity.description: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the deleteUser() API that allows authenticated non-superadmin users with delete_user permission to delete superadmin accounts. Attackers can send a DELETE request to /admin/api/user/delete with a superadmin's userId other than 1, removing administrative access and accountability.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Missing authorization in administrative API allowing deletion of superadmin accounts, impacting access control and accountability.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111905
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /admin/api/user/data/{userId}, which returns any user's full faquserdata row, including the live TOTP secret, without a SuperAdmin or protected-target check. Delegated administrators with user-management rights can read a SuperAdmin's TOTP secret and generate valid codes to bypass two-factor authentication.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: HIGH, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: IDOR exposing live TOTP secrets enabling two-factor authentication bypass and superadmin account takeover.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111901
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the unauthenticated faqs and search API endpoints. Attackers can send concurrent GET requests that load and process all database records into PHP memory, exhausting CPU and memory to crash the server.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated denial-of-service via resource exhaustion on public-facing API endpoints in widely deployed FAQ software.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111898
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows Keycloak users to take over local accounts by matching preferred_username or email. Attackers controlling a Keycloak identity with a colliding username or unverified email can log in through /auth/keycloak/authorize to bind their subject and gain superadmin privileges.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass exploiting Keycloak identity provider federation to hijack local superadmin accounts.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111895
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.0.0 and 4.0.2 before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass in its Microsoft Entra ID login flow, which links users by the mutable preferred_username claim and whose AuthEntraId::create() ignores the duplicate-login exception while continuing with the existing local account. Attackers controlling an Entra identity in the configured tenant with a matching preferred_username can take over that local account, including super-admin accounts.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass exploiting Microsoft Entra ID federation claim handling to hijack local superadmin accounts.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111881
identity.description: FreeRDP from 3.14.1 before 3.32.0 contains an integer underflow in the WinPR BMP writer, where a mismatched stride calculation passes SIZE_MAX - 3 to Stream_Zero for sub-byte images. A malicious RDP clipboard peer can return a crafted 1-bpp BMP processed by clipboard_synthesize_image_format_to_bmp for CF_DIB/CF_DIBV5, crashing the client or causing an out-of-bounds write.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: FreeRDP is widely deployed remote access infrastructure; clipboard OOB write poses enterprise remote-access risk with plausible DPI footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111882
identity.description: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0-alpha before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows IdP-authenticated users to skip TOTP two-factor authentication through the Keycloak and Entra ID SSO callbacks. Attackers holding a valid or phished IdP identity linked to a 2FA-enabled account can complete the OIDC flow and obtain a fully authenticated session, including administrator accounts.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass in SSO/OIDC callback handling that skips TOTP 2FA, directly impacting identity and access control flows.

identity.title: CVE-2026-111880
identity.description: FreeRDP versions from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contain a heap out-of-bounds write in the server hash-callback NTLM path that fails to validate the MIC offset. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted AUTHENTICATE_MESSAGE with a backward session-key offset and MIC offset to write 16 zero bytes beyond the allocation.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated remote heap OOB write in FreeRDP server NTLM authentication path, targeting widely deployed remote access infrastructure.
